newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec wants easier ASX drill reports.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec wants easier ASX drill reports.

text.p: Gulf of Mexico oil and gas producer Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd said it had asked the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) for permission to modify its weekly drilling reports, removing information which it regards as commercially sensitive.

PetSec managing director Terry Fern said the company did not want to provide sensitive information such as the exact location of a well, which became very important in Gulf blocks which were much smaller than those in Australia, but would continue to provide information such as depth and sand type. He said rivals could use sensitive information in bidding for nearby blocks.
